tasks.title: Establish the venture thesis, constraints, and plan audience
acceptance: The audience, decision, customer hypothesis, founder constraints, and planning horizon are explicit.
Missing inputs are named uncertainties with owners and next tests; authorized external actions are bounded.

tasks.title: Identify venture-killing assumptions and the first useful tests
acceptance: The founder brief has been examined for high-impact desirability, viability, feasibility, operations, team, and regulatory uncertainties.
Assumptions are ranked with explicit evidence, reversal thresholds, dependencies, and owners; proposed tests are not described as completed experiments.

tasks.title: Define the customer problem and market opportunity
acceptance: The beachhead, end user, payer, problem, alternatives, geography, and sizing units are consistent.
Material market claims cite registered evidence or explicit assumptions; unperformed customer research is not presented as completed.

tasks.title: Explain the offering, customer value, and competitive position
acceptance: The offering and customer experience address the selected problem with a measurable value hypothesis.
Alternatives, purchasing priorities, differentiation, and defensibility are supported or explicitly provisional.

tasks.title: Reconcile the business model, sales process, and unit economics
acceptance: The payer, charging unit, channels, buying process, and sales ownership agree.
Unit-economics assumptions expose inputs, separate forecasts from observations, and reconcile units, periods, contribution, acquisition costs, and payback.

tasks.title: Plan delivery capacity, costs, ownership, and contingencies
acceptance: Delivery units, demand, required and available hours, capacity gaps, and labor costs reconcile.
Material dependencies have owners, lead times, failure triggers, and fallbacks; resource constraints change commitments rather than being ignored.

tasks.title: Reconcile an integrated scenario-based cash forecast
acceptance: Conservative, base, and upside monthly forecasts recompute revenue, operating cash flow, cash continuity, minimum cash, and funding needs from explicit inputs.
Demand and costs reconcile with sales and operations; working-capital, capex, tax, and financing assumptions are explicit, with shortfall actions and qualified review where needed.

tasks.title: Prioritize risks, experiments, milestones, and conditional growth
acceptance: Critical risks and contradictions have owners, next tests, thresholds, and dates, with explicit stop or pivot conditions.
Completed validation is distinguished from proposed work; growth and resource commitments depend on named evidence gates.

tasks.title: Synthesize and review the business plan
acceptance: The plan supports its intended decision, traces material claims to evidence, and has no unresolved material factual or arithmetic errors.
A separate review records every rubric dimension, reaches at least 10/12 with no zero and evidence integrity at 2, and states its limitations.
Progress, evidence, task state, and the next action are current; review-ready status is not described as proof of business viability.
